name: TriDef 3D
summary: Third-party middleware intercepting DirectX render calls to force a second camera view. Widely bundled with 3D monitors from LG and Samsung. Supported DX9, DX10, and DX11 games. The most commercially successful stereoscopic middleware of the 3DTV era.
compatibility_notes: Defunct — Dynamic Digital Depth ceased operations in 2017. License activation servers are offline, making the software impossible to activate on a new install. Incompatible with DX12, Vulkan, and Windows 11. Of historical and collector interest only. Community successor is Geo-11.
